title: about me
text:
Levi Mackay
Computer Science Student @ BYU-Idaho | Software Developer | Computer Vision & Data Engineering | Sandbox Startup Program
I’m a Computer Science student at BYU-Idaho with interests in software engineering, computer vision, and data systems.
I enjoy building projects that combine real-time systems and structured data. Recent projects include SwingOS, a computer vision system using OpenCV and MediaPipe to provide biomechanical feedback, and a baseball analytics platform built with SQL and relational database design.
I’m currently part of BYU-Idaho’s Sandbox startup program, where I work on building software products in a fast-paced, team-based environment.
I’m actively seeking software engineering internship opportunities where I can continue growing as an engineer while contributing to meaningful products and systems.
